top.author: @tinyship_ai
top.text: Unpopular opinion: most AI tools fail because they try to be everything. The ones that stick? They do one thing absurdly well. Write one email better. Check one contract faster. Score one resume honestly. Nobody needs another "all-in-one AI platform." They need a tool that
top.translationZh: 冷门观点：大部分AI工具失败是因为想做万能工具。能活下来的都有一个共同点——把一件事做到极致。写邮件写得更好，审合同审得更快，评简历评得更准。没人需要又一个"AI全能平台"，大家要的是一个

top.author: @swizeroapp
top.text: Something I've learned building @swizero : users don't want MORE features in their email app. They want LESS email in their life. Every feature we build gets filtered through one question: does this save them time?
top.translationZh: 做 @swizero 的过程中学到一件事：用户不想要邮件应用里更多功能，而是想要生活中更少邮件。我们开发每个功能都会问一个问题：这能为他们节省时间吗？

top.author: @SideQuestStd
top.text: AI email hack that saves me 45 min/day: Instead of writing emails from scratch, I: 1. Define the outcome I need 2. List the data points to reference 3. Set my tone and constraints 4. Let AI draft → I review in 2 min The thinking is mine. The typing is AI's.
top.translationZh:
每天帮我省45分钟的AI邮件技巧：

不再从零开始写邮件，我现在这样做：
1. 明确想要的结果
2. 列出需要引用的关键信息  
3. 设定语气和要求
4. 让AI起草 → 我2分钟搞定审核

思路是我的，打字交给AI。
